verdict.rationale: PayPal supports domain-specific recurring automation. Subscription plans charge at regular intervals with automated recovery of failed payments, invoicing can send automatic payment reminders, and agents can create plans and subscriptions through the agent toolkit or MCP tools. It does not offer general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: a general job/workflow scheduler (cron-like triggers for arbitrary actions), scheduled batch payouts or reports, agent-facing scheduling primitives, and independent hands-on corroboration.
